1753-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1753-2105-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2645-3430-4644-5928.description:

Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-677-4247-6965.description:

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

5627-5671-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
5627-5671-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

Activate Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Stonespeaker Crystal which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

3179-4399-4770-7173.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-1376-4927.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-4927.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2060-2700-2744-4499-7741.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2043-3621-5226.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

443-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2267-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2034-3991-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
2034-3991-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.

2350-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2793-4779-5089-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

1661-2478-4195-4574.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4475-6109.description:
Activate Aphelia by paying {4}{B}, causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, whenever they are dealt combat damage by a Gorgon or Snake this turn.
Deal combat damage to the opponent using a Gorgon and/or Snake.
Aphelia triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

826-4508-5880-6753.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-1117-5060-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-5686-6672.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

997-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
997-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.

During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.

465-1115-3742-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-1115-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

957-5913-6122.description:

Move to your first extra turn.

When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Pinnacle Monk from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

An opponent was dealt damage this turn.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.

When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Forest Dryad token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Warbreak Trumpeter, adding {R}.
When Warbreak Trumpeter dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Warbreak Trumpeter from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Warbreak Trumpeter's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Warbreak Trumpeter triggers, creating zero tokens.
Repeat.

141-5134.description:

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.

Resolve the copy of Fated Infatuation, creating a token copy of Naru Meha and causing you to scry 2.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

Move to your next turn.
